lessons.title: Week 12 Part 1: Clarifying Weekly Case Goals & Observable Actions
lessons.content: In Week 12 of Tailored Family Safety & Growth Plan, this lesson focuses on clarifying weekly case goals & observable actions. Parents and carers practise pausing to notice stress cues, responding with calm and predictable language, maintaining child-safe boundaries, and recording one observable example of how this skill supported their child's safety and emotional wellbeing this week.
